LanguageData.LP_QuestBoard.label: exploration board
LanguageData.LP_QuestBoard.description:
A wooden board nailed full of parchment notices. Nearby adventurers' guilds, caravans, towns, wanted posters and the lakefolk of the Mana Lake post jobs for adventurers here. The board holds two kinds of commissions:
[Daily commissions] Each day a batch of tiered commissions (bronze, silver, gold, mithril, legendary) refreshes, such as holding off incoming enemies, expeditions to monster nests on the world map, and clearing hostile outposts. The higher the colony's highest adventurer level, the higher the tiers you can take. Completing one pays silver and items; the taker gets "quest points × 0.5" adventurer XP, and the colony's other members get a quarter of that.
[Renown commissions] 3 new ones every 5 days: clearing monster nests, hunting outlaws, rescuing trapped adventurers, recovering lost items, investigating haunted ruins. Once accepted, a site appears on the world map and must be completed within 7 days. Completing one gives the participants adventurer XP, silver and scrolls and raises the colony's renown: the higher the renown, the more dangerous the commissions and the better the pay; failing costs renown.
Only one per map.
